title: Card Change
tagline: Exchange Google Play Store gift cards for aDAI.
description:
Allows merchants to receive up to 90% of the original gift card value.

Our users include two groups of people:
Merchants: People who receive Google Play gift cards and want to exchange it for aDai
Purchasers: People who want to purchase items on Google Play for a discount
how_its_made:
Built with Chainlink smart contract, Google Play store API. 



Our data sources:

Using Google Play API (validate the e-gift has been sent)

Merchant receives emailed receipt as proof of purchase

Purchaser receives the Google Play store product by email

Check for voided purchases:

The user requests a refund for their order.

The user cancels their order.

An order is charged back.

Developer cancels or refunds order.

Google cancels or refunds order.
